d: Who will be the BJP’s Chief Ministerial face in Uttar Pradesh for the 2027 Assembly Elections? A series of statements by Deputy Chief Ministers Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak has sparked fresh speculation about Yogi Adityanath’s political future. While both leaders emphasise the party organisation, the BJP leadership and the lotus symbol, neither has explicitly endorsed Yogi for a third term. From the growing political equations in UP BJP to Amit Shah’s signals, Keshav Maurya’s ambitions and the party’s internal dynamics, this episode of Election Watch examines the battle for…
